content.user_title: Create Ecommerce Video Scripts From Product Facts
content.value_statement: Product facts need a clear filming plan before they can become useful short videos. This skill organizes verified details into timed shots, narration, captions, and actions.
actual_capabilities: Draft timed scripts with aligned shots, actions, narration, and screen captions from supplied product information.
Retrieve Douyin product details by product ID or URL through the documented SocialDataX CLI or corresponding MCP tools.
Retrieve Xiaohongshu product details by SKU ID or URL through the documented service tools.
Reference up to three comparable products on explicit request, with at most two additional detail checks.
Record fact sources, identify conflicting information, and flag missing details or demonstrations requiring verification.
Adapt scripts to audience, platform, duration, tone, and filming conditions, with prop and preparation notes.
limitations: Produces text scripts, not finished videos, published posts, or guaranteed sales results.
Online product retrieval supports only Douyin and Xiaohongshu; other platforms require pasted product information.
Direct CLI retrieval requires Node.js, npm, a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance.
Does not independently validate product claims, certifications, test results, or changing promotional terms.

use_cases.title: Plan a product demonstration
use_cases.description: Convert product specifications into a short filming plan with realistic actions, captions, and a closing purchase prompt.

use_cases.title: Prepare an accurate creator brief
use_cases.description: Give creators a timed script grounded in supplied facts, with unsupported claims excluded and verification tasks listed.

use_cases.title: Develop distinct campaign angles
use_cases.description: Use a small, requested sample of comparable products to suggest original presentation angles without copying claims or wording.

prompt_templates.title: Draft from supplied facts
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a 15-second script for a 500 ml insulated cup with a screw lid. Use phone filming and only these facts. Include shots, narration, captions, and actions. Do not invent insulation tests or discounts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a simple script without online retrieval.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a script to an audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this product brief: [facts]. Write a 30-second [platform] script for [audience] in a [tone] style. Align narration, captions, and actions with each time segment. List props and missing facts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: tailor a complete filming plan.

prompt_templates.title: Use supported product details
prompt_templates.prompt: Read this [Douyin or Xiaohongshu] product link: [URL], using my configured SocialDataX access. Write a 30-second script for [audience]. Preserve price conditions and cite the platform, product identifier, and query time. Flag conflicting or missing facts. Do not search comparable products.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: ground a script in supported online product details.

prompt_templates.title: Compare presentation angles carefully
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [target product facts] for a 30-second [platform] script. Reference one search page and at most three comparable products; verify at most two details. Suggest two original presentation angles, then script one. Separate target facts from suggestions. Do not copy competitor wording, specifications, certifications, or claims. List verification tasks and filming preparation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: research limited references and develop an original script.

output_examples.input: Create a 15-second phone-filmed script for a 500 ml insulated cup with a screw lid. Do not invent tests or offers.
output: 0-3 seconds: Show the cup on a table. Narration: A 500 ml cup for your drink. Caption: 500 ml.
3-10 seconds: Show the lid being unscrewed and replaced. Narration: Here is the screw lid. Caption: Screw lid.
10-15 seconds: Show the full cup. Narration: Check the product details before choosing. Caption: View product details.
Preparation: Cup, table, phone, and stable lighting.
Source: User-provided facts. Confirm dimensions and insulation performance before adding further claims.

output_examples.input: Draft a 20-second desk lamp script from these facts: three brightness settings and a USB power cable. Flag missing specifications.
output: 0-4 seconds: Show the lamp on a desk. Narration: Here is a desk lamp with three brightness settings. Caption: Three settings.
4-12 seconds: Demonstrate each setting. Narration: Show each brightness setting in the same scene. Caption: Setting 1, setting 2, setting 3.
12-16 seconds: Show the cable. Narration: It comes with a USB power cable. Caption: USB power cable.
16-20 seconds: Show the complete setup. Narration: Check the specifications before buying. Caption: View specifications.
Source: User-provided facts. Verify the actual switching method, power requirements, and whether an adapter is included.
Filming check: Capture actual brightness changes; do not claim measured eye protection or energy savings.

best_practices: Provide target product facts, audience, platform, duration, and available filming equipment before drafting.
Use supplied facts when sufficient; authorize online retrieval or comparable-product research only when needed.
Review sources, promotional conditions, spoken length, and demonstration accuracy before filming or publishing.
anti_patterns: Inventing test results, testimonials, certifications, scarcity, or discounts to make a script more persuasive.
Copying competitor wording or transferring competitor specifications and claims to the target product.
Treating unsupported platform links as retrieved evidence or running unrestricted product searches without a clear request.

faq.question: Can I use this skill without an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide enough product information, and the skill can write directly without online retrieval.

faq.question: Which product platforms support online retrieval?
faq.answer: Douyin and Xiaohongshu are supported. For other platforms, paste the product name, specifications, features, and relevant price conditions.

faq.question: What does the output contain?
faq.answer: A timed script with shots, actions, narration, captions, preparation notes, fact sources, and verification tasks.

faq.question: Does it create or publish videos?
faq.answer: No. It produces text scripts and filming guidance. It does not publish content or modify accounts.

faq.question: Can it reference competing products?
faq.answer: Yes, only when requested. Research defaults to one page, at most three references, and up to two detail checks.

faq.question: What should I know before online retrieval?
faq.answer: CLI examples execute an unpinned npm package. Approve third-party execution carefully, configure credentials locally, and check service balance before use.
